entities.name: PRP46
observations: The 473-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed Cryptococcus deneoformans PRP46 (UniProt P0CS48).
Annotated as involved in pre-mRNA splicing and required for cell-cycle progression at G2/M; localized to nucleus and cytoplasm.
GO biological processes include mRNA splicing via spliceosome (GO:0000398) and mRNA cis-splicing via spliceosome (GO:0045292).
Pfam detects seven WD40 repeat hits across residues 172–470; no catalytic reaction was retrieved.
